title: CTTS canonical clip manifest row
description: One JSONL line per clip. Model-agnostic contract between Layer 1 (corpus) and Layer 2 (per-model adapters). Schema version 0.1.0. Changes need an ADR and a version bump. Required fields come from blueprint section 2.3; the rest are optional provenance fields so that every row can be traced.

id.description: Globally unique, stable clip id, e.g. '<channel>_<video>_<seg>'.

audio_24k_wav.description: Path to 24 kHz mono WAV, relative to the corpus root (never absolute).

audio_16k_wav.description: Optional 16 kHz copy for ASR / SV judges.

text_verbatim_hk.description: Verbatim spoken HK Cantonese (口語), English kept in Latin script. Never written-Chinese subtitles.

jyutping.description: Jyutping romanisation; English tokens passed through.

speaker_id.description: Stable speaker id, prefixed by source, e.g. 'yt-mm.millmilk-chucky'. Use '<source>-unknown-<n>' if unknown.

emotion_tags.description: Optional acoustic/emotion labels, e.g. calm, animated, questioning.

single_speaker_sim.description: Cosine similarity between first-half and second-half speaker embeddings (ECAPA/WavLM). TTS training requires >= 0.75 to reject multi-speaker turns.

has_digits.description: True if text_verbatim_hk still contains Arabic digits (0-9). TTS training rows must have all numbers expanded to spoken Cantonese/English words.

source.description: Slug of the data card in data/sources/.

language_mix.description: Whether the clip code-switches into English.

colloquial_score.description: HK colloquial density score of text_verbatim_hk.

build.description: Experiment id of the build that produced this row.
